Capital Counsel Stake in Johnson & Johnson Com (JNJ) Raised by $328,735; As Dr Pepper Snapple Group (DPS) Share Value Rose, Cedar Rock Capital LTD Has Cut by $491,111 Its Stake
May 17, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Capital Counsel Llc increased its stake in Johnson & Johnson Com (JNJ) by 0.54% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Capital Counsel Llc bought 2,365 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.21% with the market. The institutional investor held 442,043 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $61.76 million, up from 439,678 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Capital Counsel Llc who had been investing in Johnson & Johnson Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $336.21 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.18% or $0.22 during the last trading session, reaching $125.35. About 3.82 million shares traded. Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) has risen 1.12% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.43% the S&P500.
Andy Brown decreased its stake in Dr Pepper Snapple Group Inc (DPS) by 0.05% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cedar Rock Capital Ltd sold 5,063 shares as the company’s stock rose 23.05% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Andy Brown held 10.06 million shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $976.83 million, down from 10.07M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cedar Rock Capital Ltd who had been investing in Dr Pepper Snapple Group Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $21.45B market cap company. (NYSE:DPS) has risen 21.65% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 10.10% the S&P500.
